text:
Priya: Quick poll — anyone up for a moonlight paddle this Saturday? low tide + waxing gibbous, should be a good glow. thinking 7:45pm launch from East Pier. bring headlamps, lights, and anything you wanna swap (paddles/booties/jackets).

Chris: Oooh that sounds awesome. I haven't done a night paddle before, is it beginner-friendly?

Priya: Totally. We'll stick close to shore and pair up. plan is casual, 60–90min max.

Jordan: Count me in. I can bring my spare 2-person dry bag and an extra paddle.

Liu: How dog-friendly is East Pier? Would love to bring Nori if it's allowed.

Priya: Nori should be fine on leash, just bring a lifevest for the pup if you have one. I can also borrow one from Sam if needed.

Sam: Yep I have an extra small canine lifejacket. happy to bring it.

Maya: I will bring thermoses of ginger tea and some energy bars. also have a neoprene mask if anyone forgot one.

Chris: Is parking near the pier limited? I can carpool if needed.

Priya: There's a small lot; plan to meet at 7:15pm at the lot entrance. carpooling appreciated.

weather-bot: Forecast link: https://weather.example/harbor — light breeze, 6°C, 10% chance of rain after 10pm.

Liu: Sweet — Nori is excited. :dog:

Jordan: Quick gear-swap note: if anyone wants to trade paddles/booties after the paddle, we can do a tiny swap table by the car park. no pressure.

Priya: Would be great! React :thumbsup: if you can make it, :wave: if you're tentative, and :x: if no. I'll DM details to anyone who RSVPs.

Chris: :thumbsup:

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup:

Maya: :wave:

Liu: :thumbsup: (bringing Nori + lifejacket)

Priya: Awesome — looks like a small crew. I'll put together a short safety checklist later today and post here. See you Saturday!
